uncertainty.interpretation: Paired whole-chain resampling, fixed recipes/checkpoints and known discovery folds. Each resample recomputes target weights/means/variances. Conditional, marginal95% intervals; not seed, training, selection or domain-shift uncertainty.

scope: Previously exposed OOF. Augmented323-input recipe utility, not isolated normalization: parameter width, initialization/RNG and data-order effects can differ. No native runtime/public qualification or automatic promotion.
